demo.title: deploy-collection.sh
demo.code:
# Describe the collection once - free, no key, nothing signed yet.
curl -s -X POST https://api.signalbound.art/collections/prepare \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"Nova Nodes","owner":"0xYOUR_WALLET","chainId":8453,"maxSupply":2222,"mintPriceEth":"0.001","maxMintPerWallet":20,"maxCreatorMints":20,"artStyle":"creature","agentBaseURI":"https://agents.example.com/nova/"}'

# The reply hands back creationBytecode, constructorArgs, params and verify.
# Send them as one creation transaction: no 'to', no value, on the chainId it
# echoed. Then read owner() back and verify with the reply's verify block.
# Every token resolves to an ERC-8004 registration whose RESTAP endpoint is
# <agentBaseURI><id> - or an honest empty services list when none was given.
# Each token also answers ERC-8048 metadata(id, key) reads on-chain, and
# traits(id) publishes the trait values each token's art was drawn from.

setup: Ask for name, supply, mint price, per-wallet cap, creator reserve and chain - and the wallet that will own the collection
Optional: `agentBaseURI`, where each token's agent is served; every token ships an ERC-8004 registration with an optional RESTAP endpoint, plus an ERC-8048 (ERC-721T) agent profile readable on-chain
Deploy the pack's creation bytecode with no `to` and no value, read `owner()` back, then verify with the pack's `verify` fields
